result.title: FlowSim: Rendering-Free Closed-Loop Simulation for Evaluating End-to-End Driving Systems
result.summary: Closed-loop evaluation of end-to-end (E2E) driving systems typically relies on generating sensor observations and re-processing them through the perception encoder, introducing substantial computational cost and a sim2real gap between simulated and real sensor observations. In this paper, we ask a more fundamental question: is image-space simulation necessary for closed-loop evaluation of E2E driving systems? We propose FlowSim, a rendering-free simulation paradigm that predicts the internal latent representation directly from a previous latent and target-frame symbolic scene conditions. The predicted latent is then processed by the original frozen downstream modules, eliminating image rendering and perception re-encoding. Explicit cross-frame agent association improves latent transition prediction and rollout stability, while variable-horizon simulation enables long-horizon prediction from a common real anchor without accumulating intermediate rollout errors. Experiments on nuScenes and NavSim demonstrate that FlowSim preserves downstream behavior competitively with, and often exceeds image-space simulation in source-to-reference agreement across variable simulation horizons and both dense and sparse latent representations. By predicting the latent directly, both instantiations of FlowSim simulate each step in 0.04--0.06s, substantially faster than the image-space simulation methods they are compared against. These results establish FlowSim as an efficient and practical alternative to conventional image-space simulation methods.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FlowSim，一种免渲染的闭环仿真方案：由前一帧隐表示与目标帧符号场景条件直接预测下一帧内部 latent，再交由冻结的下游模块处理，从而省去图像渲染与感知重编码；在 nuScenes 与 NavSim 上验证其行为一致性与运行速度。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「直接预测 latent 状态驱动冻结下游模块」的做法，可能为 LVR 中隐状态跨步更新与 rollout 保真度的评估、以及绕过视觉重建后下游是否仍能使用隐内容提供方法线索，可供核查其跨帧关联与可变视界预测是否保留任务必要信息。
